The structure of Co8O16F16 (reduced formula Co(OF)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Co centers, with Co–O/F geometric neighbor distances of 1.89–2.08 Å, and the Co octahedra show corner- and edge-sharing. O and F centers each have two Co neighbors, while the F environment is geometrically coordinated by a single Co atom. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
